purpose: Quantify how baseline Candidate6 score, concurrent inflammation change, chemistry version, and released author-pair membership affect the Stage003 CT-colonocyte longitudinal association.

main_branch.aggregation: Restrict to site pairs with evaluable CT state; average baseline, follow-up, and Post-minus-Pre quantities equally across eligible sites within patient.

required_descriptions: Patient-level baseline, follow-up, and change distributions by remission
Welch group comparisons at baseline and follow-up
Pearson correlation between baseline Candidate6 and Candidate6 change
HC3 ANCOVA: follow-up Candidate6 ~ remission + baseline Candidate6
HC3 association decomposition: Candidate6 change ~ remission + baseline Candidate6 + inflammation change
HC3 extended association decomposition adding baseline inflammation
technical_rule: Because all remitters use 10x v3.1 and all v3 patients are non-remitters, an unrestricted chemistry-stratified remission permutation is not identifiable. Report the cross-tabulation and the v3.1-only subset instead.
interpretation: The original unadjusted exact permutation remains the planned exploratory Stage003 result. Stage003F is a mandatory post-result qualification. It must not be described as prospectively specified or as a replacement validation.
causal_boundary: Inflammation change may be part of the same recovery process; adjustment is used to describe shared longitudinal variation, not to estimate a controlled direct or causal effect.
